**Legend**
- `proven★` — view data on the operator's own channel in this niche
- `proven` — view data from this niche's own ecosystem (competitor / audience-tab), recorded in the overlay
- `inherited` — carried from a sibling niche; the overlay has a niche example, and may have produced titles, but no niche view data yet
- `untested` — no niche example and no evidence; usable the moment a topic supplies the raw material
- `endorsed` — operator's call, no data yet (converts to `proven` on the first win)
- `dead` — ruled dead in this niche (see the overlay's `dead-list.md` for the re-test date)
- `excluded` — operator ruled it out for this niche; do not re-propose at transfer audits

Cell notes: *(p)* = produced in the niche's latest batch, data pending; *(face)* = face/persona channels only; *(search)* = search-dial channels only; *(machine)* = machine lane only; *(weak)* = usable but weak transfer.
